notes.title: Save The Village 1.2.0 Update Notes
notes.content:
Version: 1.2.0
Update Time: April 18, 2025 20:20 (GMT+3)

Hey everyone,
We're excited to announce the release of Update 1.2.0, which brings significant improvements to difficulty levels, tower stats, and various bug fixes!

[b]Key Changes & Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Difficulty Level Adjustments: We've rebalanced the difficulty levels to provide a more refined and balanced experience across all modes (Easy, Normal, Hard). Expect a smoother progression and more satisfying challenge.
[*] Tower Durability & Range Enhancements: We've made adjustments to tower durability and attack ranges to improve their overall effectiveness in combat. Towers should now feel more impactful and strategic to use.
[*] Dragon Fire Effects: Enhanced the visual effects of dragon fire attacks for a more immersive and visually stunning experience.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:
[/b]
[list]
[*] Dragon Fire Effects: Fixed visual glitches and optimized the performance of dragon fire effects.
[*] Leaderboard Issues: Addressed and resolved several bugs related to leaderboard rankings and data accuracy.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support and feedback! We hope you enjoy the enhanced gameplay experience in Update 1.2.0.

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Save The Village 1.1.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Version: 1.1.1
Update Time: March 6, 2025 15:01 (GMT+3)

Hey everyone,

We've just released a small patch (v1.1.1) to address a few key issues that some of you have been experiencing. Here's a rundown of the fixes:

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Perks & Upgrades Availability: [/b]Fixed an issue where certain perks would become unavailable for purchase in the Perks & Upgrades screen after returning to a previous village on the map.
[*] [b]Accidental Upgrade Purchase: [/b]Resolved a bug where pressing the purchase button in the Perks & Upgrades screen without selecting any perk/upgrade in the late game would incorrectly repurchase the first upgrade.
[*] [b]Enemy Damage Display:[/b] Enemies' damage amounts are now correctly displayed as whole numbers instead of with decimal points.
[/list]

Thank you for your patience and continued support! We appreciate your bug reports and feedback.
Let us know if you're still experiencing any of these issues, or if you encounter any new ones!

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Save The Village 1.1.0 Update Notes
notes.content:
Version: 1.1.0
Update Time: March 5, 2025 15:55 (GMT+3)

Hey everyone,

We're excited to announce a new update for the game, bringing new challenges and improved atmosphere! Here's what's new:

[h3]New Features:[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Difficulty Levels:[/b] You can now choose your preferred difficulty level right from the start screen! Select between Easy, Normal, and Hard modes to tailor the game to your playstyle.
[*] [b]The Final Challenge:[/b] No matter which difficulty you choose, the final level will always be on "Hard" difficulty. This ensures fairness for everyone competing on the Steam Leaderboard, as the final level is where scores are recorded.
[/list]

[h3]Changes:[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Enhanced Village Ambience:[/b] We've completely revamped the background music during battles in all villages. The new tracks are designed to create a more immersive and fitting atmosphere for each location.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy these new additions and changes! Let us know what you think in the comments below.

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Demo v1.1.0 Released
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who downloaded our demo and gave feedback. Initial feedback was generally about the UI. We immediately implemented these requests and released the update today. Here are the release notes:

1. Quit button on main menu is now under Play button. It was difficult to understand meaning of Home icon. Which was quit to desktop :-) Now it's clear.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235697/1460c5daab7b5fd7e22430cdf6da78c38e729331.png[/img]



2. Some players asked why towers were not attacking the target. That's why we've added target types to the tooltips of the tower building buttons.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235697/e85b8968ae91084ecdbfb39aff84f00de8367fdb.png[/img]



3. Due to the second request, we decided that it would be a great idea to add some data such as life and damage when clicking on the towers.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235697/fe583d4905fbc49edfd403a456cd515e06d1f233.png[/img]



4. Finally, the feedback "I don't understand what that green thing is that helps to upgrade towers or unlock abilities on the perks screen" was very clear :-) We made it so that it is now clearly visible when you save the village. That green thing is Diamond :D


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235697/39795232ef9aae05c174663ee933deb16ada5cff.png[/img]



Thank you again to everyone who took the time to play our demo, give feedback and add Save The Village to their wishlists. Thanks to you, our motivation increases and we become happy. 

With love and respect

notes.title: A Medieval Makeover: Redesigning the UI, Logo, and Environment
notes.content:
As we continue developing [b]Save The Village[/b], the game has naturally evolved in both scope and style. What started with a more casual, mobile-inspired user interface (UI), logo, and blocky environment has grown into something far more epic. It became clear that we needed a visual overhaul to match the heart of the game. Enter our new[b] medieval-themed UI[/b], [b]logo[/b], and a completely redesigned [b]natural[/b], [b]stylized environment[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235697/28a7ecd692438369e40203c1a8fb8aff8a603cad.png[/img]

[h3]Why We Changed It[/h3]
When we first started working on [b]Save The Village[/b], the game had a lighter, more casual aesthetic that leaned into the feel of a mobile game, with a blocky, simplistic environment. But as we explored the game’s world, its characters, and the atmosphere we wanted to build, we realized it deserved a richer, more immersive presentation. The original visuals no longer reflected the serious, strategic gameplay that was emerging.

With the game rooted in a fantasy-driven medieval world, we decided to embark on a redesign that reflects both the [b]essence of defending a medieval village[/b] and the more natural, atmospheric environments that players expect in a PC tower defense game.

[h3]The New Environment[/h3]
One of the most significant changes we made was to the game’s environment. Initially, the world was built using blocky, simplified designs that worked well for early prototypes but felt out of place in the evolving game. Now, we’ve embraced a [b]more natural[/b], [b]stylized look[/b], replacing the rigid blocks with flowing landscapes, rolling hills, and more intricate details that make the villages feel alive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235697/b93197f27a3e6daa78b4f2055310e8b53f2c5b90.png[/img]

This change enhances the immersion, creating a world that feels authentic to the medieval setting while retaining a stylized charm that adds to the game’s unique personality.

[h3]The New UI and Logo[/h3]
Alongside the environment update, we completely reworked the game’s UI and logo. The old, casual style has been replaced with deep tones, aged parchment textures, and [b]medieval-inspired elements[/b] that evoke the feeling of an ancient battlefield. Our new logo features [b]bold[/b], [b]sharp typography[/b] with symbols of defense and war, representing the strength and seriousness of the gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235697/babbfb8621e8ac684e9979cbb14e794b264fb39b.png[/img]

[h3]A Better Fit for Our Game[/h3]
This overhaul isn’t just about aesthetics—it reflects the [b]growth of Save The Village[/b] as a game. From a basic tower defense prototype, it has evolved into a deep, strategy-focused experience with a medieval world full of knights, skeletons, and epic battles. The new environment, UI, and logo now perfectly capture the [b]immersive and strategic nature[/b] of the game, setting the stage for a thrilling defense experience.

We’re thrilled to share this new look and feel for [b]Save The Village[/b] as we continue our journey towards launch. Stay tuned for more updates as the game progresses!
